2013;Cast:Sangeeta Nair, Utkal Hazarika. In this cult action comedy from Assam, young man Charlie wants only to win over his girlfriend's family, but ends up crossing paths with a host of madcap characters - a wannabe number one under-18 don, his elder brother - an actual don, the brother's classical singing sidekick, and a thief rumoured to go around naked. The freshness and rawness of this film catapulted it to cult status among the youth of Assam
